newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's blue chip index hits new closing high.
newsitem.headline: Spain's blue chip index hits new closing high.

text.p: Madrid's Ibex-35 blue chip stock index rose 1.24 percent on Tuesday to a new closing high at 6,969.92, bolstered by strong gains in key stocks in thinner than usual trade after a rise on Wall Street, dealers said.
The Madrid general stock index gained 1.33 percent to its fresh closing high at 608.58.

Dealers said there was less volume on Tuesday with some dealers cautious ahead of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee, which is expected to give more indications on the short term trend in markets, although most expect no change in key U.S. money rates.
In Spain, the market is being underpinned by flows of funds from traditional fixed-income instruments into the stock market, bolstering expectations of further gains medium-term.
